confs.description: Study-wide settings: name, ad account, credentials, opt window.

How the study spends: one of three recruitment strategies, discriminated on `type` (`simple`, `pipeline_experiment`, `destination`). The tag may be omitted, in which case the arm is inferred from shape for backwards compatibility - but a written tag is the only way to be sure which arm you get.
Where respondents are sent. Discriminated on `type`.
Ad creatives, each naming the destination it recruits into.
Custom audiences derived from responses, and lookalikes of them.
Experimental variables and their levels, used to derive strata.
The recruitment cells: quota, creatives, audiences and targeting.
Response sources to pull from. Stored under the key `data_sources`.
How to extract inference variables from responses. Stored under the key `inference_data`.
